effects.description:
When spawning: Acquire a defensive shield (durability: 20% of max HP).
While defensive shield is active, enemy attacks will reduce shield durability instead of HP, and it will inflict Stagger on the enemy who attacked you. (Excludes some attacks.)

skills.detail:
A long-range attack that pulls the enemy to your position.
Also deals a mid-range attack.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
Acquires ATK debuff effect at Level 5.
skills.name: You'll Pay for That!!

skills.detail:
Reduces damage received from enemies and unleashes a mid-range area attack while the skill button is held down.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.

Deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect after a certain amount of time has passed or when the skill button is released.
You are able to move while holding down the skill button.

Damage dealt will disregard the enemy DEF stat.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Winch Guillotine
